cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

mechanism: A corrects the attribution of support for a building extension, requiring a visible identifiable endorsement to withstand objections.
confusable: D08 might seek praise; D52 must secure attributable backing for a contested decision, not admiration alone.
comparison: Rota alternative changes communication medium; extension alternative negotiates name visibility and an initials key.
seedUse: Extension signature and initials key derive from D52-b; S03 adds document-verification correction in place of a metaphor about support having an address.
